text_block_list.text:
King Halo claimed a brilliant first-place 
finish in the Satsuki Sho, the opening leg 
of the Classic Triple Crown route.

"As expected of that lady's daughter!"... 
With praise like that from the fans at her 
back, King Halo was certain of herself.

If she keeps this up, she can even take 
first place at the Japanese Derby—the 
stage everyone dreams of. If she does 
that, she's sure to finally earn their 
recognition.
